description: 熊本市_地下水観測井水位 [sewerage and wastewater and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本市. 2009年以降の熊本市環境局が管理している地下水観測井の水位のデータ ※機器故障等のため一部欠損（データの空白）があります。 ※出典は「熊本市環境局」と記載して下さい。. Coverage: 熊本市. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本市. Its tags are 地下水, 環境. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
